non_idle_rule: After every result or interruption, immediately analyze, log, and launch the next experiment. The watchdog recovers only declared queued workers. When the queue is empty, the primary Codex process must plan and enqueue the next experiments. Wait only for an active process, active Codex planning, or required external operation. Stop only on exact top-level STOP.
current_hypothesis: A small BFCL-only run tests whether the mapped Live examples transfer; full preference training and the combined corpus then test whether more in-domain and cross-source data improve clean validation and aggregate test metrics.
experiment_queue: Use outputs/qwen-when2call-qwen25-15b-pref-full-control-seed20261031 as the identical initialization for every candidate. This checkpoint was trained on all 7,200 When2Call train_pref rows and has clean preference validation accuracy 0.896111 and macro F1 0.672815. Its aggregate-only test accuracy and macro F1 are 0.666210 and 0.492468.
Train only on 500 sampled APIGen-MT conversations; split conversations before extracting one action example, and omit direct-answer cases from the training rows.
Train only on 500 sampled ToolACE conversations with the same split and label extraction rules.
Train only on a matched mixture of 250 APIGen-MT and 250 ToolACE conversations.
Train only on 500 xLAM irrelevance conversations, testing the explicit mapping from an empty answers list to cannot_answer.
Train only on 500 Hermes single-turn conversations from func_calling_singleturn.

For each candidate, evaluate training, clean preference validation, source validation, and aggregate-only black-box test at epoch end or each 1,000 updates, whichever comes first. Stop after two consecutive clean-preference-validation accuracy evaluations fail to improve over the best checkpoint. Test metrics are report-only.

Continue auditing Tool Calling English 100K, Narrative Function Calling, ToolAlpaca, API-Bank, ToolBench, and API-BLEND. Add experiments only after access, data provenance, license, and label mapping are cleared.

best_validation.reason: The old encoder saw full preference training data and macro F1 conventions differed.

last_action: Queued the three requested fresh-base experiments in order. The watchdog and independent supervisor must launch one worker at a time.

best_observed_test.selection: Best observed result among four methods frozen before this benchmark measurement. This does not establish independent generalization.

next_hypothesis: After all usable standalone sources have results, compare only the sources that improve clean preference validation accuracy and then test combinations.

post_queue_report_required.trigger: After every queued standalone dataset trial is complete and before queueing mixtures.
post_queue_report_required.contents: Compare each source trial with the common starting adapter. Report clean validation and aggregate black-box test accuracy and macro F1, baseline deltas, sample and usable training-row counts, limitations, and whether any new data helped.
post_queue_report_required.selection: Use clean preference validation to identify helpful sources. Report aggregate test results only, with no individual test labels or outcomes.

future_policy.stop_rule: For experiments after the three fixed runs, stop at the first epoch where clean held-out validation accuracy does not improve.
future_policy.test_metrics: Report aggregate black-box accuracy and macro F1 at each evaluation. Never use test metrics for checkpoint selection or continuation.
future_policy.reported_metrics: Training accuracy and macro F1, held-out validation accuracy and macro F1 when available, and aggregate black-box test accuracy and macro F1.

open_ended_phase: After the three queued runs, use their clean-validation evidence to prioritize standalone data and synthetic-data hypotheses. Do not generate data until a concrete hypothesis and cost estimate are recorded.
